monsoon.scope: Seasonal prevailing direction is a simplified game calendar. Speeds, certainty of storms and casualty rates are explicit user rules, not historical measurements or weather forecasts.

discovery_policy: Active coastal board cities only; unknown sea crossings are optional exploration. Reveal a route after a surviving force reaches land, even before a subsequent enemy-city siege. Zero troop survivors/cancelled marches reveal nothing.
casualty_policy: Soldiers only; generals are retained. Army survivors use total floor plus largest remainders, not per-general independent rounding. One sea-storm draw per complete voyage; terrain hazards can additionally apply.
timing_policy: Departure month fixes forecast and severity roll; quote is read-only. Known-route lengths use geographic waypoints; special land times use plain-road baseline rather than multiply the old mountain time.
